name: Emily
description: Works at the saloon and practices crystal healing on the side. Bright, creative, and happiest when you bring gems or cloth.

seo.title: Emily — Salon Stylist
seo.description: Works at the saloon and practices crystal healing on the side. Bright, creative, and happiest when you bring gems or cloth.

stardew.intro: Haley's sister and the saloon's evening bartender. Spiritual, colorful, and always interpreting signs from the universe.

heartEvents.title: Dream visit
heartEvents.summary: Enter her house while she sleeps — you appear in her abstract dreamscape.

heartEvents.title: Injured parrot
heartEvents.summary: A parrot hits her window in town; she nurses it back to health in her room.

heartEvents.title: Secret dance
heartEvents.summary: She performs a private dance routine in her room — react kindly.

heartEvents.title: Clothing therapy
heartEvents.summary: At the Mayor's Manor she hosts a group fashion session for the town.

heartEvents.title: Camping in the woods
heartEvents.summary: A bear visit during a Secret Woods campout leads to a romantic night.

relationships.name: Haley
relationships.note: Sisters with opposite personalities — Emily is the free spirit, Haley the perfectionist.

relationships.name: Gus
relationships.note: Employer at the Stardrop Saloon; she tends bar most evenings.

trivia: Cloth from your loom is a reliable loved gift once you have sheep or rabbits.
